description: Renew a domain you own. Returns USDC payment requirements (402), or pay_with=balance to renew instantly from prepaid balance. pay_with=card returns status needs_human (code SCA_REQUIRED) with a single-use Stripe checkout link (card_pay_url): give it to a person, who opens it and completes card payment (card fee added; the card issuer may ask the person to approve it). The agent cannot complete card payment itself; poll check_order until the person has paid.

chain.description: payment network (default base). hyperevm = HyperEVM (chain 999, USDC/USDT0), bsc = BNB Chain (56, 18-decimal USDC/USDT)

pay_with.description: crypto (default: USDC/USDT, x402 or transfer), balance (prepaid balance), or card: returns a single-use Stripe pay link that a person opens and pays; the agent does not pay by card itself

name: renew_domain
title: Renew a domain
